description: Expose a Cube TCP port on the host, optionally restricted to specific IPs/CIDRs.

cubeId.description: The Cube id to operate on.

spaceId.description: Krova Cloud Space id. Optional if KROVA_SPACE_ID is set as the server default.

udpEnabled.description: Whether to also forward UDP traffic on the same host port, in addition to TCP. UDP is forwarded by default — leave this unset to get UDP forwarding, and only pass false to disable it.

whitelistIps.description: Deprecated alias for whitelistedIps. Accepted so existing agent prompts keep working; prefer whitelistedIps.

whitelistedIps.description: Optional IP/CIDR allow-list restricting who can reach the mapping.

name: create_tcp_mapping
title: Create TCP Mapping
